name: heavy_8at
source: Game-owned heavy-duty 8-speed planetary torque-converter automatic for big-torque engines (automatic gearbox swap, 2026-10-16), NOT a specific gearbox [AS]. Ratios and efficiencies are physics_sim's sedan_8at (data/gearboxes/sedan_8at.json: 4.70-0.67, spread ~7) so the step pattern stays the published 8-speed planetary one; the capacities are scaled for engines up to the 750 N*m catalogue rating: shift clutches 1000 N*m kinetic input-referred (1.33 x the rating, the sedan box's 400 N*m keeps 2 x its 200 N*m engine; heavier clutch packs [AS]), lock-up clutch 1000 N*m. Converter [AS]: K-factor 102 rpm/sqrt(N*m) at stall, chosen so a 600 N*m engine stalls the converter near 2500 rpm (n = K sqrt(T)); the K curve keeps sedan_8at's shape scaled by 102/179; torque ratio 2.0 at stall as sedan_8at. Bigger pump/turbine (0.12 / 0.05 kg*m^2) and input/output inertias than the sedan box [AS]. Shift timing as sedan_8at (torque phase 0.15 s, inertia-phase bound 0.6 s, engage 0.35 s) [AS].
